scripts.clearSFC: find $(realpath .) -type f \( -name '*SFConf*' -o -name '*.sbak' \) | while read item; do echo "$item"; rm -f "$item"; done
scripts.l10n: echo Generating app_localizations_xx.dart from app_xx.arb; cd app && flutter gen-l10n
scripts.server-run-dev: echo CLEAN=$CLEAN; if [ "$CLEAN" = "true" ]; then echo Renaming old data...; mv server/data server/data.$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S); fi; cd server && npm run dev
scripts.coturn-run-docker: cd server/docker/coturn; sudo docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d;
scripts.server-run-docker: cd server/docker; sudo git pull; echo CLEAN=$CLEAN; if [ "$CLEAN" = "true" ]; then echo Removing old data...; mv ../data ../data.$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S); fi; echo MIRROR=$MIRROR; if [ "$MIRROR" = "true" ]; then sudo docker compose build --build-arg NPM_MIRROR=https://registry.npmmirror.com --build-arg NODE_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/node --build-arg BETTER_SQLITE3_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/better-sqlite3 server && docker compose up -d server; else sudo docker compose up -d --build server; fi; docker compose logs -f server
scripts.server-update-remote: ssh.sh cn1 'cd /faronear/einz/; sudo git pull; npm run coturn-run-docker; MIRROR=true npm run server-run-docker'
scripts.app-apk-boot2run: ADB="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb"; EMU_BIN="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/emulator/emulator"; if "$ADB" devices | grep -q 'emulator-5554'; then echo '✅ 模拟器 emulator-5554 已在运行，跳过启动'; else echo '▶ 启动模拟器 einz_emu（后台）…'; if [ "$CLEAN" = "true" ]; then AVD_DIR="$(grep -m1 '^path=' "$HOME/.android/avd/einz_emu.ini" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2)"; if [ -n "$AVD_DIR" ] && [ -d "$AVD_DIR/snapshots/default_boot" ]; then rm -rf "$AVD_DIR/snapshots/default_boot"; echo '🗑 CLEAN=true：已清除 quick-boot 快照，本次冷启动（防坏快照卡住 adb 上线——老板 2026-10-19 定）'; fi; fi; nohup "$EMU_BIN" -avd einz_emu >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo '▶ 等待 adb 设备上线…'; "$ADB" wait-for-device; echo '▶ 等待系统开机完成…'; until [ "$("$ADB" shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ]; do sleep 2; done; echo '✅ 模拟器开机完成'; fi; printf '选择运行配置 [local / local-clean / remote / remote-clean]（回车默认 local）: '; if [ -n "$npm_config_mode" ]; then SERVERMODE="$npm_config_mode"; echo "$SERVERMODE"; else read -r SERVERMODE; fi; case "${SERVERMODE:-local}" in local) npm run app-apk-run;; local-clean) CLEAN=true npm run app-apk-run;; remote) SERVERMODE=remote npm run app-apk-run;; remote-clean) CLEAN=true SERVERMODE=remote npm run app-apk-run;; *) echo "未知配置: $SERVERMODE"; exit 1;; esac
scripts.app-apk-run: bash scripts/patchPubCache.sh; cd app; DEFINE_FROM_FILE=''; if [ -f localConfig.android.json ]; then DEFINE_FROM_FILE='--dart-define-from-file=localConfig.android.json'; fi; SERVERMODE=${SERVERMODE:-local}; DEFINE_SERVER=''; if [ "$SERVERMODE" = 'local' ]; then DEFINE_SERVER="--dart-define=kEinzServer=http://10.0.2.2:3000"; fi; echo CLEAN=$CLEAN; echo SERVERMODE=$SERVERMODE VOICE_MODEL=${VOICE_MODEL:-false}; if [ "$CLEAN" = "true" ]; then echo Removing old data...; flutter install -d emulator-5554; fi; bash ../scripts/insertVoiceModel.sh android flutter run -d emulator-5554 $DEFINE_FROM_FILE $DEFINE_SERVER --pid-file /tmp/einz_flutter_android.pid
scripts.app-apk-reload: LEVEL=${LEVEL:-1}; echo; echo LEVEL=$LEVEL; echo 'Reloading Android App'; kill -USR$LEVEL $(cat /tmp/einz_flutter_android.pid)
scripts.app-apk-build: bash scripts/patchPubCache.sh && cd app; eval "$(node ../scripts/appVersion.js)" && TURN_ARGS="$(bash ../scripts/turnDefineArgs.sh)" && bash ../scripts/insertVoiceModel.sh android flutter build apk --release $TURN_ARGS --build-name "$APP_BUILD_NAME" --build-number "$APP_BUILD_NUMBER" && mkdir -p ../_release.gitomit && RELEASE="../_release.gitomit/einz-app-android-v${APP_BUILD_STAMP}.apk" && mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk $RELEASE && echo && echo ======= Moved to ======= && ls -lh $RELEASE
scripts.app-ios-run: echo 必须先取UDID因为node_modules路径; UDID="$(bash node_modules/wo_scripts/emuUdidIos.sh "${EMU:-}")"; cd app; DEFINE_FROM_FILE=''; if [ -f localConfig.ios.json ]; then DEFINE_FROM_FILE='--dart-define-from-file=localConfig.ios.json'; fi; SERVERMODE=${SERVERMODE:-local}; DEFINE_SERVER=''; if [ "$SERVERMODE" = 'local' ]; then DEFINE_SERVER="--dart-define=kEinzServer=http://localhost:3000"; fi; echo CLEAN=$CLEAN; echo SERVERMODE=$SERVERMODE VOICE_MODEL=${VOICE_MODEL:-false}; if [ "$CLEAN" = "true" ]; then xcrun simctl uninstall "${UDID}" cc.tic.einz; fi; bash ../scripts/insertVoiceModel.sh ios flutter run -d "${UDID}" $DEFINE_FROM_FILE $DEFINE_SERVER --pid-file /tmp/einz_flutter_ios.pid
scripts.app-ios-boot2run: npm run app-ios-boot && npm run app-ios-run
scripts.app-ios-reload: LEVEL=${LEVEL:-1}; echo; echo LEVEL=$LEVEL; echo 'Reloading iOS App'; kill -USR$LEVEL $(cat /tmp/einz_flutter_ios.pid)
scripts.app-ios-init: cd app && flutter pub get && cd ios && pod install
scripts.app-ios-build: BUILDMODE=${BUILDMODE:-appstore}; echo "BUILDMODE=$BUILDMODE (adhoc,appstore)"; bash app/ios/buildIos.sh $BUILDMODE && cd app && eval "$(cat build/ios/ipa/version.txt)" && mkdir -p ../_release.gitomit && RELEASE="../_release.gitomit/einz-app-ios-${BUILDMODE}-v${APP_BUILD_STAMP}.ipa" && mv build/ios/ipa/einz.ipa $RELEASE && echo && echo ======= Moved to ======= && ls -lh $RELEASE
scripts.app-ios-build-raw: cd app; find build/ios -name '*.sbak' -print -delete 2>/dev/null; eval "$(node ../scripts/appVersion.js)" && TURN_ARGS="$(bash scripts/turnDefineArgs.sh)" && flutter build ios --release $TURN_ARGS --build-name "$APP_BUILD_NAME" --build-number "$APP_BUILD_NUMBER"&& eval "$(cat build/ios/ipa/version.txt)" && mkdir -p ../_release.gitomit && RELEASE="../_release.gitomit/einz-app-ios-raw-v${APP_BUILD_STAMP}.zip" && ditto -c -k --keepParent --sequesterRsrc build/ios/iphoneos/Runner.app $RELEASE && echo && echo ======= Zipped to ======= && ls -lh $RELEASE && rm -fr build/ios/iphoneos/Runner.app
scripts.app-ios-install-adhoc-ip6s: bash app/ios/buildIos.sh adhoc && ideviceinstaller -u 01418b9159ab75651272f3e5616c3e3fc5dd7d1e install app/build/ios/ipa/einz.ipa
scripts.app-ios-install-adhoc-ip11-raw: ls ~/Library/MobileDevice/Provisioning\ Profiles/; cd app; find build/ios -name '*.sbak' -print -delete 2>/dev/null; flutter build ipa --release --export-options-plist=ios/exportOptionsAdhoc.plist; ls -la build/ios/ipa/einz.ipa; xcrun devicectl list devices; rm -rf /tmp/einz-ipa && mkdir -p /tmp/einz-ipa; unzip -q build/ios/ipa/einz.ipa -d /tmp/einz-ipa; xcrun devicectl device install app --device 00008030-0005306011F9402E /tmp/einz-ipa/Payload/Runner.app
scripts.app-mac-build-raw: cd app && find build/macos -name '*.sbak' -print -delete 2>/dev/null; eval "$(node ../scripts/appVersion.js)" && TURN_ARGS="$(bash ../scripts/turnDefineArgs.sh)" && bash ../scripts/insertVoiceModel.sh macos flutter build macos --release $TURN_ARGS --build-name "$APP_BUILD_NAME" --build-number "$APP_BUILD_NUMBER" && mkdir -p ../_release.gitomit && RELEASE=../_release.gitomit/einz-app-macos-raw-v${APP_BUILD_STAMP}.zip && ditto -c -k --keepParent --sequesterRsrc build/macos/Build/Products/Release/einz.app $RELEASE && echo && echo ======= Zipped to ======= && ls -lh $RELEASE && open build/macos/Build/Products/Release/einz.app --args --server http://localhost:3000
scripts.app-mac-build: BUILDMODE=${BUILDMODE:-dist}; echo "BUILDMODE=$BUILDMODE (dev,dist,nonotary)"; if [ "$BUILDMODE" = 'dev' ]; then BUILDARGS='--adhoc --server http://localhost:3000'; elif [ "$BUILDMODE" = 'dist' ]; then BUILDARGS=''; elif [ "$BUILDMODE" = 'nonotary' ]; then BUILDARGS='--no-notary'; fi; bash app/macos/buildMacos.sh $BUILDARGS
scripts.app-mac-run: echo "▶ macOS debug · 设置服务器：路径①：--server http://localhost:3000 运行期覆盖，同 buildMacos.sh --server <SERVER> 路径②： 编译期烘入 --dart-define=kEinzServer=<SERVER> 或 --dart-define-from-file=localConfig.macos.json 里的地址· 数据落在容器内 dev/ 子目录 + 独立 Keychain 前缀，不碰正式客户端"; CLEAN=${CLEAN:-false}; echo VOICE_MODEL=${VOICE_MODEL:-false}; if [ "$CLEAN" = "true" ]; then bash scripts/cleanMacDev.sh || exit 1; fi; cd app; DEFINE_FROM_FILE=''; DEFINE_SERVER=''; if [ -f localConfig.macos.json ]; then DEFINE_FROM_FILE='--dart-define-from-file=localConfig.macos.json'; fi; SERVERMODE=${SERVERMODE:-local}; if [ "$SERVERMODE" = 'local' ]; then DEFINE_SERVER="--dart-define=kEinzServer=http://localhost:3000"; fi; RUNTIME_SERVER=''; if [ -n "$SERVER" ]; then RUNTIME_SERVER="--server=$SERVER"; fi; bash ../scripts/insertVoiceModel.sh macos flutter run -d macos $DEFINE_FROM_FILE $DEFINE_SERVER --dart-define=SHOW_MESSAGE_AVATARS=true --dart-define=einzDevDataDir=dev --dart-define=einzSecurePrefix=einz.secure.dev. $RUNTIME_SERVER --pid-file /tmp/einz_flutter_macos.pid
scripts.demo-assets: cd app && GEN_DEMO_ASSETS=1 flutter test --tags generator
scripts.app-mac-reload: LEVEL=${LEVEL:-1}; echo; echo LEVEL=$LEVEL; echo 'Reloading Mac App'; kill -USR$LEVEL $(cat /tmp/einz_flutter_macos.pid)
scripts.app-all-reload: LEVEL=${LEVEL:-1}; npm run app-ios-reload; npm run app-apk-reload; npm run app-mac-reload;
scripts.app-create-appstore-screenshots: bash app/integration_test/screenshots_drive.sh & cd app && flutter test integration_test/screenshots_test.dart -d <模拟器ID> --dart-define=SHOT_DIR=/tmp/einz_shots
scripts.tui-cli: STORE=${STORE:-default}; STORE_FILE=~/.einz/store_$STORE.json; echo CLEAN=$CLEAN; if [ "$CLEAN" = "true" ]; then echo Renaming old store $STORE_FILE ...; mv $STORE_FILE $STORE_FILE.$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S); else echo Resuming old store $STORE_FILE; fi; SERVERMODE=${SERVERMODE:-local}; DEFINE_SERVER=''; if [ "$SERVERMODE" = 'local' ]; then DEFINE_SERVER="--server http://localhost:3000"; fi; cd cli && dart run bin/einz_tui.dart --store ~/.einz/store_$STORE.json $DEFINE_SERVER
